veranderings.blok: Hoe malaria voel en wat jy doen
veranderings.rede: 'Malariagebied' is the established Afrikaans term; 'malariaplek' is an ad hoc compound.
Same term as in the study block, so the lesson uses the standard compound consistently.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Die siek mens hou ook aan eet en 'n baba hou aan borsdrink
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Under the AWS 2017 rule this needs a comma before 'en' (two clauses, each with its own subject and verb: 'Die siek mens hou ... aan eet, en 'n baba hou aan borsdrink'); the protected wording blocks the fix, so a person should decide whether the protected entry may carry the comma.
